EXPENSE_FREQUENCY_STATCARD.title: Expense Frequency
EXPENSE_FREQUENCY_STATCARD.info: Shows how often expenses occur within the selected period.

INCOME_FREQUENCY_STATCARD.title: Income Frequency
INCOME_FREQUENCY_STATCARD.info: Shows how often income is received within the selected period.

NO_SPEND_DAYS_STATCARD.title: No-Spend Days
NO_SPEND_DAYS_STATCARD.info: Counts the number of days in the period with zero expense transactions.

TOP_EXPENSE_CATEGORY_STATCARD.title: Top Expense Category
TOP_EXPENSE_CATEGORY_STATCARD.info: Highlights the category where the most money was spent.

TOP_INCOME_CATEGORY_STATCARD.title: Top Income Category
TOP_INCOME_CATEGORY_STATCARD.info: Highlights the category that contributed the most income.

TOP_EXPENSE_TRANSACTION_STATCARD.title: Top Expense Transaction
TOP_EXPENSE_TRANSACTION_STATCARD.info: Displays the single largest expense transaction in the selected period.

TOP_INCOME_TRANSACTION_STATCARD.title: Top Income Transaction
TOP_INCOME_TRANSACTION_STATCARD.info: Displays the single largest income transaction in the selected period.

BURN_RATE_STATCARD.title: Burn Rate
BURN_RATE_STATCARD.info: Shows the average daily spend rate to indicate how fast funds are being consumed.

SAVINGS_RATE_STATCARD.title: Savings Rate
SAVINGS_RATE_STATCARD.info: Displays the percentage of income that was saved after expenses.

INCOME_TREND.title: Income Trend
INCOME_TREND.info: Visualises income over time as a line or area chart to reveal growth or decline patterns.

EXPENSE_TREND.title: Expense Trend
EXPENSE_TREND.info: Visualises expenses over time to highlight spending patterns and anomalies.

BALANCE_TREND.title: Balance Trend
BALANCE_TREND.info: Tracks net balance over time, showing whether finances are improving or deteriorating.

INCOME_CATEGORY_TREND.title: Income by Category Trend
INCOME_CATEGORY_TREND.info: Breaks down income trends per category over time using stacked or multi-line areas.

EXPENSE_CATEGORY_TREND.title: Expense by Category Trend
EXPENSE_CATEGORY_TREND.info: Breaks down expense trends per category over time using stacked or multi-line areas.

BALANCE_YEAR_COMPARISON.title: Balance Year Comparison
BALANCE_YEAR_COMPARISON.info: Overlays balance curves from multiple years on a single chart for direct comparison.

INCOME_EXPENSE_COLUMN.title: Income vs Expense
INCOME_EXPENSE_COLUMN.info: Side-by-side columns comparing total income and expenses for each period.

EXPENSE_CATEGORY_COLUMN.title: Expense by Category
EXPENSE_CATEGORY_COLUMN.info: Grouped or stacked columns showing expense breakdown across categories per period.

MONTHLY_BALANCE_COLUMN.title: Monthly Balance
MONTHLY_BALANCE_COLUMN.info: A column chart of net balance per month to quickly spot positive and negative months.

EXPENSE_SAVINGS_COMBO.title: Expense & Savings Combo
EXPENSE_SAVINGS_COMBO.info: Combines a bar series for expenses with a line overlay for cumulative savings.

TRANSACTION_COUNT_EXPENSE_COMBO.title: Transaction Count & Expense Combo
TRANSACTION_COUNT_EXPENSE_COMBO.info: Overlays transaction volume as a line on top of expense bars to reveal spending intensity.

WEALTH_GROWTH_COMBO.title: Wealth Growth Combo
WEALTH_GROWTH_COMBO.info: Combines income and expense bars with a cumulative wealth line to track net growth.

EXPENSE_PIE.title: Expense Distribution
EXPENSE_PIE.info: A pie or donut chart showing the proportional share of each expense category.

INCOME_PIE.title: Income Distribution
INCOME_PIE.info: A pie or donut chart showing the proportional share of each income category.

SPENDING_RADAR.title: Spending Radar
SPENDING_RADAR.info: A radar chart mapping spending levels across categories for a holistic balance view.

MONTHLY_CATEGORY_RADAR.title: Monthly Category Radar
MONTHLY_CATEGORY_RADAR.info: Compares category spending patterns across multiple months on a single radar chart.

CATEGORY_AVG_POLAR.title: Category Average Polar
CATEGORY_AVG_POLAR.info: A polar area chart displaying average spend per category, where segment size encodes magnitude.

MONTHLY_PEAK_POLAR.title: Monthly Peak Polar
MONTHLY_PEAK_POLAR.info: A polar area chart highlighting peak spending months with proportional segment sizing.

CATEGORY_BUBBLE.title: Category Bubble
CATEGORY_BUBBLE.info: Plots categories as bubbles where position indicates timing and size encodes total amount.

TRANSACTION_SCATTER.title: Transaction Scatter
TRANSACTION_SCATTER.info: Scatters individual transactions by date and amount to expose outliers and clusters.

SPENDING_HEATMAP.title: Spending Heatmap
SPENDING_HEATMAP.info: A calendar heatmap showing daily spending intensity across the year at a glance.

CATEGORY_TREEMAP.title: Category Treemap
CATEGORY_TREEMAP.info: Nested rectangles sized by spend amount to show category and sub-category proportions.

CATEGORY_BOXPLOT.title: Category Boxplot
CATEGORY_BOXPLOT.info: Displays the statistical distribution of transactions per category including median and outliers.

MONTHLY_BOXPLOT.title: Monthly Boxplot
MONTHLY_BOXPLOT.info: Displays the statistical distribution of daily spending per month to reveal variability.

SAVINGS_RATE_GAUGE.title: Savings Rate Gauge
SAVINGS_RATE_GAUGE.info: A radial gauge showing the current savings rate against a configurable target threshold.

YEARLY_SLOPE.title: Yearly Slope
YEARLY_SLOPE.info: A slope chart connecting year-start to year-end values to make directional change immediately obvious.

CATEGORY_SANKEY.title: Category Sankey
CATEGORY_SANKEY.info: A flow diagram showing how income is distributed and consumed across expense categories.
